title: Wooden Bow
body:
"Simple, reliable and great for picking off goblins from a distance."

Description

The Wooden Bow is a flimsy piece of wood made into a bow. it is the Starter ranged weapon available for purchase for $800. It deals low damage and has a moderate firing range and speed.

Like all other starter weapons, it is available without completing The Arena.

Like all other ranged weapons it auto aims, which could make targeting a specific enemy a challenge.
